meta: Part 1 of "Your own AI assistant": turn AI into an assistant that knows you. Every new chat, AI forgets who you are, so you have to introduce yourself again. Custom instructions fix that.

muc.title: Your own assistant
muc.text: You now understand how AI works. This six-part series turns it into your own assistant. Part one: teach AI who you are.

muc.title: Introducing yourself every time
muc.text: Every time you open a new chat, AI forgets who you are. You have to start over: what you do for work, what kind of answers you want.

muc.title: A note stuck on the desk
muc.text: Chat apps have a place called custom instructions. It's like a note stuck on the assistant's desk: every time you start, AI reads it first.

muc.title: Before and after
muc.text: Same question, but with this note the answer is shorter, closer to your work, and uses the tone you like.

muc.title: What to write there
muc.text: Just three things: who you are, whether you want long or short answers, and how you'd like AI to talk to you. Don't put passwords or account numbers here.

muc.title: Three lines about you
muc.text: Go to settings, find personalization, write three lines about yourself and save. Open a new chat and try a question you often ask.

muc.title: Prompts you type again and again
muc.text: But what about the prompts you type over and over every day? Part two shows how.
